headline: The garden walks: spider, scorpion and fleas land in CENTIPEDE
lede: Slot b's shift put 1981's three wanderers into CENTIPEDE — the arcade's eating spider, the venom-scorching scorpion, and the flea you summon by firing into empty sky, which rains bonus mushrooms when shot. The real-key drive caught (and pinned) a stale-bullet bug that diverged identical seeds.

notes.text: CENTIPEDE gap 0 closed whole: spider (eats caps, bounces, bravery bands 900/600/300), scorpion (poisons full caps red; centipede segments that cross venom race at double pace), flea (sky-shot summon on cooldown, every hit rains two seeded mushrooms).
centipedadrive caught a real bug: init() never cleared bullets, so a stale volley across a reset diverged two same-seed drives. Fixed, pinned by a new gate, determinism rollout byte-identical after.
Proof: centipedechek 59/0, mutants 17/17 die, drive 15/15 in real Chrome, lint gates + build green.

zorkcheck flaked once on CI Chrome (shifting-Forest stop, 56/57) — green locally 58/58 and green on retry; static cleared and the menagerie merged. If it strikes a third time it earns its own harness issue.
